summary_en: Misumi authorized acquisition of up to 200,000 shares (3.52% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 400 million yen through market purchases on the Fukuoka Exchange from October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 25, 2026, Misumi's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock. The company will purchase up to 200,000 shares of its common stock, representing 3.52% of outstanding shares (5,671,034 shares excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026), for a maximum total purchase price of 400 million yen, or approximately 2,000 yen per share. Purchases will be conducted through market transactions on the Fukuoka Exchange between October 1, 2026 and September 30, 2027.

The company cited two primary objectives: enhancing capital efficiency in response to changing business conditions and returning capital to shareholders. The authorization is based on the company's articles of incorporation and the Company Law provision allowing acquisition of treasury stock through board resolution.
